scope: Binomial level capacities retain complete finite orbit profiles. Exact weighted refinement controls both domain and range error, and a Borel address map identifies hyperfinite type III_lambda relations with the biased binary tail relation under the stated modular normalization and standard-Borel foundations. Six solved exercises accompany the construction.
